name: Linco Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Linco Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells vacuum sputtering and plasma treatment equipment. It offers in-line sputtering, in-line plasma surface treatment, and double door vertical type thermal evaporation coating equipment. The company also provides OEM services, such as surface decoration coating (SDC), anti-electro-magnetic interference (EMI) coating, non-conductive vacuum metallization (NVCM), and functional coating; and other services, including vacuum components, spare parts and accessories, maintenance, and emergency on-site repairs.
